r.t: Kaguya Shinomiya is the titular protagonist of the Kaguya-sama wa Kokurasetai series. She was a student at Shuchi'in Academy, a member of the Archery Club, and the Vice President of the 67th and 68th Student Council.
Cyan: Full Scale IQ, Crystallized and Fluid Intelligence, Intelligence Categories
She excels in theater, music, and martial arts
After half a year, Kaguya and Miyuki develop feelings for each other and begin to plan ways to get the other to confess said feelings
Chika Fujiwara, the student council member secretary, wanted to give a pair of movie tickets she won to the two of them, since her parents won’t let her go due to family restrictions
Chika also brings up a myth about if a boy and girl watch that movie together, they’re guaranteed to start dating,

and planned beforehand by carefully preparing a fake prize, slipping it into Fujiwara’s mailbox, and finding a movie on the weekend on one of Miyuki’s rare breaks, all to use to her advantage in order to have Miyuki ask her out
She also sees through Miyuki’s strategy of leaving it up to her
and uses the skill “Feigning Innocence” to throw Miyuki off
Kaguya and Miyuki began to play a game of Old Maid, a game where players take turns drawing cards and all pairs are discarded
The winner gets to make a request of the loser
Her goal was to throw the game and manipulate whatever request Miyuki was going to make via tears
Miyuki thinks of Kaguya in a swimsuit or maid outfit
However, Kaguya immediately shuts down the option of making lewd requests,
implying that she knew what Miyuki was thinking
She casually answers each one of Chika’s riddles correctly
, such as correctly guessing which number goes to which letter/direction (East is 3, West is 9, South is 6, and North is 12), something that Miyuki fails to accomplish
Shirogane could make against going to the beach
She tries to have Shirogane confess to her in his sleep by manipulating his dreams

. She could also figure out how deep of a sleep he is in by touching his eyelids due to the eyes moving rapidly during REM sleep. When in REM sleep, the brain continues to work, causing dreams. And the brain is still able to process auditory information during this time, allowing Kaguya to manipulate Shirogame’s dreams by speaking to him
using her servants to convince Shirogane to buy a smartphone
That way, he can attempt to get her contact information  later on
In order to get Shirogane to show a childhood photo and lose his bargaining chip over her, she pretends to cry and call him cruel for it
She creates a false love letter and accepts to go on a date with a random guy
in order to have Shirogane stop her and have him admit his feelings towards her
She bit down on her tongue to prevent herself from smiling at Shirogane
Is able to speak French Fluently, only having difficulty with pronunciation because one rarely uses naval vowels in Japanese
It’s to the point where she was able to terrify Betsy,
who has two victories in the French Debate meet, and uses quick thinking and logic to deny her opponent’s most basic way of thinking
She deduces that Shirogane knew that it was going to rain today because he took the train instead of riding his bike to school
Has been second only to Shirogane in terms of the school exams for the past three exams, which were about science and liberal arts
Having known Fujiwara since junior high school, she is able to anticipate her behavior more easily than tomorrow’s weather forecast

She knew Fujiwara would grab a psychology test book from the library, so she already reviewed the book. And since she already knows the significance of the questions, she won’t get caught providing a revealing answer (such as with Page 47, question 2, which asks “who tapped your shoulder while you’re walking down a dimly lit road”, which would be the person you like)

In order to make Shirogane ask her for a ride during a thunderstorm, she manipulates him by saying how a contributing member of society would never miss work over something like that, and that he should either pay for a taxi, which costs more than he makes on his job, or ask someone to give him a ride

However, immediately after this she gets a notification that the trains have resumed service. In order to prevent Shirogane from finding out, she replaces the battery in his phone with a dead one, all within one minute before Shirogane returns to the room. Kaguya has long predicted a wide range of scenarios and prepared the necessary tools to entrap Shirogane. This dead battery is one of them. An item to be deployed in a situation in which Shirogane's phone must be disabled

Kaguya comes up with the idea to get closer with Shirogane’s sister Kei, in order to also get closer with him. She presents herself as helpful and generous to Kei, projecting an image of the type of girl a person would want as an older sister

The day after giving Shirogane cake and a fan for his birthday, she goes to tell Chika that Shirogane’s birthday was yesterday, so that Chika would believe Shirogane is in love with her and spread that rumor to make others believe it as well
Shirogane attempts to counter this by explaining that he personally didn’t tell her his birthday, and that she only found out because it was in the student
He also questions why she didn’t share that information with their friends
She had a counter to this, but was distracted by Shirogane fanning himself with the fan she got for him
